articles.title: Auburn upsets No. 1 Georgia with walk-off field goal
articles.summary: For the first time since October 1990, the No. 1 team in the country has lost in back-to-back weeks. No. 1 Georgia is the latest top-ranked team to fall after Auburn made a 34-yard field goal to win 27-24.

articles.title: Hagan, Basketball Hall of Famer and Kentucky legend, dies at 94
